blocks.text: An unidentified number of students have been killed or injured in an explosion inside a school in eastern Afghanistan’s Kunar province, according to an Afghan government official speaking to Al Jazeera.

The blast took place on Saturday morning a school in Kunar’s Andar Ser area, according to Farid Dehqan, spokesperson for the Kunar Provincial Police Headquarters, quoted by the Associated Press news agency.
There was no immediate information on what caused the explosion. Investigative teams from Kunar province, which is located on the border with Pakistan, were at the scene, Dehqan said.
In August, a hand grenade attack at a school complex in the Afghan capital of Kabul wounded more than 40 children aged between 9 and 14.
